title: Sketch Explainer
style: A blueprint: pale lines on deep blue, a fine grid, hand-drawn strokes that draw themselves on (use the engine's pencil/Gfx strokes or stroke-dash reveals), mono hand labels, one warm accent for the answer. The camera pans across one large drawing.
learnsFrom: Technical explainer sketches and pen-plotter drawings.

story.what: title draws itself: 'How a meeting finds its time' with an underline
three people are sketched (Ana, Ben, Kai), each with a lane
each lane fills with busy blocks (hatched) across Mon–Fri; the camera pans along the week
a vertical scan line sweeps; where all three lanes are free it leaves an accent box: Thu 3:00
the box lifts into an invite drawn in line: 'Thu 3:00–4:00 · Ana, Ben, Kai'; arrows to the three people, each gets a check
pull back to the whole sheet; stamp 'ORIEL · fictional · drawn in code'

sizes: Landscape is primary (lanes run left to right). Vertical turns the week to run top to bottom and stacks the people across the top.
sound: beatScore soft at 90 bpm: pencil scratches as ticks while strokes draw, a hit when the answer box lands, the sign-off with the stamp.
teaches: Drawing-on is its own motion language: stroke order is the story.
